entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 同一ケース・同一入力でskillなし/ありの対照を取り、発見、選択、作法順守、証拠追跡、非機能・世界モデル欠落、安全境界をクライアント別に記録し、未検証データはgovernance-requiredになること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Build a new evaluation package and verifier; keep actual client execution and authority external.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Committed runs are example-only and do not establish independent client behavior, skill causality, or semantic validity.
entries.expectation_state: Matched-run schema, verifier, fixtures, CLI routing, portable bundles, and provisional governance boundary implemented.
entries.mismatch_state: Committed runs are example-only and do not establish independent client behavior, skill causality, or semantic validity.
